commit.//: Commit changes to both main repo and private submodule with synchronized commit messages. Usage: nx run git:commit "message"

push.//: Push both repositories (submodule first, then main repo)

postinstall.//: Points git at the repo's tracked hooks, .githooks/, whose pre-commit refuses a commit whose private-note stubs publish more than the placeholder (vault:guard-private). Runs on `pnpm install`.
